subject: Urgent: suspected SAML session export — request for IRP + evidence transfer
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@corebank.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: secops@corebank.com, joe.patel@corebank.com
Date: 2026-05-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Unusual SAML exports observed — need IRP & artifacts

Jonas / Redwood security team,

We observed multiple SAML assertion downloads tied to a service account that integrates with Redwood (app id redwood-prod-7). We’ve quarantined the sessions but need your incident response plan, a short timeline of activities you will take, and a copy of any relevant logs/telemetry for the time window 2026-05-04 22:00 — 2026-05-05 02:00 UTC.

Can you also confirm whether any customer data was egressed? Our compliance team (Joe Patel) is standing by and we may need a quick legal/retainer discussion.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Nguyen
Sr. Security Engineer, CoreBank
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@corebank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-05T09:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Unusual SAML exports observed — need IRP & artifacts

Alice — thanks for the heads up and for the timestamps. We’ll treat this as an active IR. Immediate actions:

- I’m spinning up a dedicated channel with CoreBank and our on-call IR team (Marissa owner for forensics, Karthik owner for telemetry exports).
- Marissa will prepare a sanitized evidence bundle and a proposed redaction plan.
- Karthik will pull token logs, access records, and the KV-cache hit timeline for the timeframe you specified.
- Ben will coordinate legal/retainer support and confirm whether we need a Statement of Work or a scoped retainer for deeper forensics.

I’ll share the internal Incident Response Plan (IRP) excerpt for third parties now and an expected ETA for the artifact bundle (within 8 hours). If you need a faster turnaround, please let us know and we’ll prioritize accordingly.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@corebank.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-05T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Unusual SAML exports observed — need IRP & artifacts

Alice — attaching the first evidence bundle for your review. Contents: timestamped access list (CSV), session traces (redacted), and a lightweight timeline (TXT).

Attachment stubs: ir-extract-corebank-20260505.zip (encrypted), redaction_guidance-corebank.pdf

Notes / ask:
- We redacted account numbers and PII per our standard procedure; redaction guidance doc explains fields we removed. If you need a fully unredacted set for legal review we can escalate but we’ll need an NDA/retainer confirmation.
- Preliminary look: no large object storage egress detected; there are several short-lived API calls that retrieved metadata. We’re continuing deeper checks on token reuse and IP correlations.

ETA: expanded forensic package and CAIQ/SIG evidence mapping by EOD 2026-05-05 (target 17:00 UTC).

Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@corebank.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: joe.patel@corebank.com, secops@corebank.com
Date: 2026-05-05T13:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Unusual SAML exports observed — need IRP & artifacts

Thanks Marissa — received the bundle and redaction guidance. A few quick asks from our side:

1) Can Redwood provide the IRP section that covers third-party evidence handoff and retention windows (specifically SOC 2-related retention expectations)?
2) We will likely need a temporary access window to a sanitized S3 bucket for our legal team to pull the logs for 24 hours. Please advise the preferred transfer method.
3) CoreBank Legal (cc Joe) requires a retainer form/DocuSign for deeper engagement and unredacted artifacts. JD will send the PO if we confirm cost/terms.

If Redwood can provide the IRP excerpt and a DocuSign retainer link, we’ll expedite the PO and proceed.

— Alice
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: alice.nguyen@corebank.com, joe.patel@corebank.com
Date: 2026-05-06T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Unusual SAML exports observed — need IRP & artifacts

- Generated a scoped retainer (DocuSign link below) to cover up to 8 hours of forensics and one targeted unredacted evidence handoff. The PowerForm includes NDA language and a standard cost schedule.
- Created an expiring signed S3 pre-signed URL workflow for sanitized bundles; CoreBank will confirm the access window. For unredacted material we will request a signed retainer and PO first.
- Attached: redaction_guidance-corebank.pdf (again) and the encrypted evidence stub.

DocuSign retainer (PowerForm): https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&po=12345
GDrive evidence staging: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleIRPack

-Ben
